section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses limitations of a single study examining body appreciation in men (Study X), which recruited 432 participants (131 sexual minority men and 301 heterosexual men) primarily from the YMCA in the UK. Key limitations include the correlational nature of the data, partial questionnaire administration, low internal consistency on some measures among sexual minority men, limited assessment of potential factors, unequal representation of sexual minority men, recruitment from a single source (YMCA), lack of standardized physical activity definition, and use of multiple imputation for missing data.
